observedLimitations.repairSuggestion: Retain already observed trajectory across brief gaps within grace, without extrapolating invented positions. Allow sweep pose to tolerate finger pose noise while rejecting closed pinches.

observedLimitations.finding: 619-629 are six missing samples; 631-643 are fist=true and pinch=false though source image shows C grasp. _grip rejects them before considering C geometry.
observedLimitations.repairSuggestion: Evaluate C grasp geometry and the already-established holding state before using the coarse fist flag as a hard rejection. Long missing intervals should freeze safely, not silently claim tracking succeeded.

observedLimitations.finding: Frame647 has openRelease=true, 649/651 false, then653/655 are spuriously grip=true. Stable open release is not observed until663/665; pure dwell may delay release from21.43s to22.13s.
observedLimitations.repairSuggestion: Use change of opening relative to prior captured grasp and sustained loss of grip, in addition to full-palm classification.

observedLimitations.finding: Visible open palm is recognized with only2 extended long fingers; _openRelease=false cuts the pull segment and can stop progress below phase-grab gate despite full source row.
observedLimitations.repairSuggestion: After release, allow open pull pose hysteresis using geometry and low pinch strength; do not require every frame to independently classify three long fingers extended.

observedLimitations.finding: Every requested sample in745-771 is missing; the true phase endpoint pickup and beginning of lift are entirely unobserved at15fps with this full-frame model. This is a detector gap, not just sequence thresholds.
observedLimitations.repairSuggestion: Improve detector input/detail and robust tracking or add a constrained recovery at the observed lifted small moon. Do not invent a successful pickup event or label a forced checkpoint pass as end-to-end success.

observedLimitations.finding: Thumb and index are true, other fingers false; opening/handSize1.47/1.48/1.50, below default lReleaseOpening1.55, so _lRelease=false throughout source release.
observedLimitations.repairSuggestion: Use opening increase from held baseline and a lower L opening threshold around1.3; still require established pickup and upward-left lift.

observedLimitations.finding: Fist flags stable957-985; openPalm true991/993. The final original fist->open transition has adequate real model observations.
observedLimitations.repairSuggestion: Keep the sequence requirement and proximity; this local action should be verifiable independently of earlier detector gaps.
